motions.item_title: Consent to the appointment of Jason Allen for Planning Commission for a three-year term beginni…
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to consent to the appointment of Jason Allen for Planning Commission for a three-year term beginning January 2026 through December 2028. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Jason Allen seated on the Planning Commission
motions.summary: The council agreed to Jason Allen serving a three-year Planning Commission term, January 2026 through December 2028.
motions.impact: Residents who show up to speak on a development proposal will find him among the commissioners hearing it. No other effect.

motions.item_title: Consent to the appointment of Brent Strong for Planning Commission for a three-year term beginn…
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to consent to the appointment of Brent Strong for Planning Commission for a three-year term beginning January 2026 through December 2028. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Brent Strong seated on the Planning Commission
motions.summary: The council agreed to Brent Strong serving a three-year Planning Commission term, January 2026 through December 2028.
motions.impact: Another seat filled on the board that hears zoning and subdivision requests first. Day to day, this changes nothing for you.

motions.item_title: Consent to the appointment of Bryan Free for Planning Commission for a one-year term beginning…
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to consent to the appointment of Bryan Free for Planning Commission for a one-year term beginning January 2026 through December 2026. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Bryan Free joins the Planning Commission for a year
motions.summary: The council agreed to Bryan Free serving on the Planning Commission for a one-year term running through December 2026.
motions.impact: The Planning Commission reviews zoning and building proposals before they reach the council, so anyone following a development near them may see this name on hearing agendas.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to consent to the appointment of Susan Allen for Senior Advisor for a three-year term beginning January 2026 through December 2028. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Susan Allen's Senior Advisor term confirmed
motions.summary: A second vote confirmed Susan Allen as Senior Advisor for the January 2026 to December 2028 term.
motions.impact: The same appointment, recorded twice. There is nothing here for a resident to act on.

motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to approve the Consent Agenda, removing item 13.A. from the agenda to be discussed at a later date, and to update the minutes from the December 16, 2025, City Council Meeting to reflect that the motion on item 12.A. passed with a 3:0, not a 3:2 vote. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent items approved, one pulled and a vote count fixed
motions.summary: The council approved its consent agenda, pulled item 13.A for a later meeting, and corrected the December 16 minutes to show a 3-0 vote instead of 3-2.
motions.impact: Bookkeeping on the written record, plus one item pushed to a future agenda. Nobody outside the clerk's office feels this.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.120 General Fencing/screening provisions
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapter 17.60.120 General Fencing/screening provisions. Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Fence and screening rules changed
motions.summary: The city changed the part of its code that governs fences and screening, though the motion does not spell out the new provisions.
motions.impact: If you are putting up a fence or screening on your property anywhere in the city, check the current code before you build. The rules that apply to you have changed.

motions.item_title: Deny the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to deny the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: failed for lack of a majority vote, 2:3.
motions.headline: Move to reject Hidden Hollow amenity swap
motions.summary: The council took up a proposal to reject the Hidden Hollow amenity change outright rather than leave it for a later meeting.
motions.impact: Nothing is settled for Hidden Hollow either way: the amenity change was neither approved nor finally rejected at this meeting.

motions.item_title: Table the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Clark seconded the motion
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to table the Hidden Hollow Amenity Exchange (Minor) Site Plan Amendment. Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Hidden Hollow amenity swap put on hold
motions.summary: The council delayed a decision on a minor change to the amenities planned for the Hidden Hollow development.
motions.impact: If you live in or are buying into Hidden Hollow, the proposed change to the development's amenities is still unsettled and will come back to the council later.

motions.item_title: Appoint Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to appoint Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Melissa Clark named Mayor Pro Tempore
motions.summary: The council appointed Melissa Clark as Mayor Pro Tempore, the member who runs meetings when the mayor is absent.
motions.impact: A standing-in arrangement for council meetings. Nothing about city services or your bills changes.
